SELECT
  SUM(qty) AS bags_sold,
  SUM(line_amount) AS revenue_inr,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills_with_atta,
  MIN(bill_ts)::date AS first_sale_date,
  MAX(bill_ts)::date AS last_sale_date
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND bill_ts <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00';

WITH atta_days AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, b.book_on_hand_close,
         a.audit_ts, a.status
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=d.sku AND f.date=d.date
  JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.sku=d.sku AND b.date=d.date
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku=d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date=d.date
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
)
SELECT * FROM atta_days ORDER BY date;

WITH empty_audit_days AS (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS date
  FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
    AND audit_ts <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND status='empty'
), estimate AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day,
         GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold, 0) AS lost_bags_est,
         GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - d.units_sold, 0) * p.price_inr AS lost_sales_inr_est
  FROM empty_audit_days e
  JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date=e.date
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=d.sku AND f.date=d.date
  JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=d.sku
)
SELECT 'AUDIT_AVAILABILITY' AS metric, NULL::date AS date,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf')::numeric AS on_shelf_or_lost_bags,
       COUNT(*)::numeric AS audits_or_value,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf')/COUNT(*),2)::numeric AS pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND audit_ts <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'EMPTY_DAY_DETAIL', date, units_sold::numeric, forecast_units_per_day, lost_sales_inr_est
FROM estimate
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LOST_SALES_ESTIMATE', NULL, SUM(lost_bags_est), SUM(lost_sales_inr_est), NULL
FROM estimate
ORDER BY metric, date NULLS FIRST;

SELECT d.sku, d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, b.book_on_hand_close,
       a.status AS audit_status
FROM store.daily_sales d
JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=d.sku AND f.date=d.date
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.sku=d.sku AND b.date=d.date
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku=d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date=d.date
WHERE d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND (d.units_sold=0 OR a.status='empty')
ORDER BY d.sku, d.date;

WITH june AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, p.price_inr,
         a.status AS audit_status
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=d.sku AND f.date=d.date
  JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=d.sku
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a
    ON a.sku=d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date=d.date
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date, COUNT(*) AS recorded_days,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0))
    FILTER (WHERE audit_status='empty') AS empty_audit_lost_bags_est,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0)*price_inr)
    FILTER (WHERE audit_status='empty') AS empty_audit_lost_inr_est,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0))
    FILTER (WHERE units_sold=0) AS all_zero_sale_days_lost_bags_est,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0)*price_inr)
    FILTER (WHERE units_sold=0) AS all_zero_sale_days_lost_inr_est
FROM june;

SELECT 'sales' AS section, d.date::text AS key, d.units_sold::text AS v1,
       b.book_on_hand_close::text AS v2, f.forecast_units_per_day::text AS v3
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.sku=d.sku AND b.date=d.date
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=d.sku AND f.date=d.date
WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date < DATE '2026-06-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'audit', audit_ts::text, sku, status, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'count', count_ts::text, book_before::text, counted::text, trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY section, key;

SELECT d.date, d.sku, d.units_sold, b.book_on_hand_close,
       a.status AS audit_status
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.sku=d.sku AND b.date=d.date
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku=d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date=d.date
WHERE d.date IN (DATE '2026-06-11',DATE '2026-06-12',DATE '2026-06-13',
                 DATE '2026-06-23',DATE '2026-06-24',DATE '2026-06-25',
                 DATE '2026-06-26',DATE '2026-06-27')
ORDER BY d.date, d.sku;

SELECT 'POS' AS source, bill_id, bill_ts::text AS ts, line::text AS line_no,
       gtin_scanned, sku_scanned, qty::text AS qty, unit_price::text AS price,
       line_amount::text AS amount
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts::date IN (DATE '2026-06-11',DATE '2026-06-12',DATE '2026-06-23',
                        DATE '2026-06-24',DATE '2026-06-25',DATE '2026-06-26')
  AND sku_scanned LIKE 'ATTA%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PAYMENT', p.bill_id, p.ts::text, p.attempt::text, p.tender, p.till_status,
       p.amount_inr::text, COALESCE(p.rrn,''), COALESCE(p.note,'')
FROM payments.pos_payments p
WHERE p.ts::date IN (DATE '2026-06-11',DATE '2026-06-12',DATE '2026-06-23',
                     DATE '2026-06-24',DATE '2026-06-25',DATE '2026-06-26')
  AND p.till_status <> 'approved'
ORDER BY source, ts, bill_id;

SELECT 'POS' AS source, bill_id, bill_ts::text AS ts, line::text AS line_no,
       gtin_scanned, sku_scanned, qty::text AS qty, unit_price::text AS price,
       line_amount::text AS amount
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts::date IN (DATE '2026-06-11',DATE '2026-06-12',DATE '2026-06-23',
                        DATE '2026-06-24',DATE '2026-06-25',DATE '2026-06-26')
  AND sku_scanned LIKE 'ATTA%'
ORDER BY ts, bill_id;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS dataset, MIN(date)::text AS first_date, MAX(date)::text AS last_date, COUNT(*)::text AS rows
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.forecasts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.inventory_book;

WITH atta AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, p.price_inr,
         a.status AS audit_status
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=d.sku AND f.date=d.date
  JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=d.sku
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku=d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date=d.date
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE audit_status='on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE audit_status='empty') AS empty_audits,
  COUNT(audit_status) AS total_audits,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE audit_status='on shelf')/COUNT(audit_status),2) AS osa_pct,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0))
    FILTER (WHERE audit_status='empty') AS lost_bags_est_empty_audit_days,
  ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0)*price_inr)
    FILTER (WHERE audit_status='empty'),2) AS lost_inr_est_empty_audit_days,
  SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0))
    FILTER (WHERE units_sold=0) AS lost_bags_est_all_zero_days,
  ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,0)*price_inr)
    FILTER (WHERE units_sold=0),2) AS lost_inr_est_all_zero_days
FROM atta;
